_note: Monthly rules and calendar refresh (BETA_CONVERSATION_SPEC 3.3; app/research/rules_refresh.py). targets: per policy file, the items to check: glob is a path of keys and list indexes where * matches every key or index (keys starting with _ are skipped), fields are the values the model reads from the item's source, sources names the item's key holding its URL (a string or a list; the first https URL is read). Items sharing a URL are checked with one page read and one model call; each counts against PAI_RULES_REFRESH_MAX_CALLS. A value becomes a proposed diff only when its quote is verbatim on the page and passes required_checks, and it differs from the current value. Nothing is applied: scripts/apply_refresh.py applies a reviewed proposal. validation_tests are what apply_refresh runs before keeping a change.
